claims.content: To securely remove files and folders from disk, avoiding possible data recovery.

goal.raw_text: To securely remove files and folders from disk, avoiding possible data recovery.

claims.content: PeaZip is open and accessible via the file manager interface, create archive window, or extraction window.
User has selected one or more files or folders for deletion.
The user presses the Shift+Del key combination while one or more files or folders are selected.

trigger.raw_text: The user presses the Shift+Del key combination while one or more files or folders are selected.

claims.content: The system initiates the secure file deletion procedure intended to securely remove files and folders from disk, avoiding possible data recovery.
The system implements the deletion by performing multiple successive passes of the deletion procedure over the storage area of the selected for deletion file.
Files and folders are permanently removed from disk.
Data recovery is avoided (no possibility of data recovery).
